LanguageData.ARIO_WartimeBridgeUnavailable: [A Rim of Ice and Fire] Wartime incidents are unavailable because the core diplomacy API could not be found: {0}
LanguageData.ARIO_StrengthLarge: a war band of considerable size
LanguageData.ARIO_SkirmishBody: Outriders from {FACTION} have crossed into your lands. Scouts count {STRENGTH}.\n\nThis is the ordinary grind of war - patrols meeting patrols - but blades are out and your people are in their path.
LanguageData.ARIO_MajorBattleBody: {FACTION} has committed to the field. Banners are up and the line is coming on: {STRENGTH}.\n\nThis is no patrol clash. Everyone who can hold a weapon will be needed, and those who live through it will not be the same afterwards.
LanguageData.ARIO_ScoutsBody: Riders from {FACTION} have been spotted nearby. Your scouts estimate {STRENGTH}.\n\nThey will be on you within half a day. You have time to prepare - use it.
LanguageData.ARIO_DesertersBody: {COUNT} soldier(s) have slipped away from {FACTION}'s host and thrown themselves on your mercy. They have had their fill of the war and ask only for a roof and work.\n\nThey have joined your House.
LanguageData.ARIO_CallToArmsBody:
{LIEGE} has summoned your household to war and demands that you raise your banner against {FACTION}.

The enemy fields {STRENGTH}. If you answer, {LIEGE} will send troops to fight beside you - and the battle will be joined here, on your ground.

Refusing will not be forgotten.
LanguageData.ARIO_CallToArmsRefused: You refused {0}'s call to arms. Your liege will remember it.
LanguageData.ARIO_CallToArmsAnswered: You answered the call. {0} sends {1} troops to fight beside you.
LanguageData.ARIO_AmbushBody: {FACTION} slipped past your watch. There was no warning and there is no time to form up - {STRENGTH} is already on your ground.
LanguageData.ARIO_RequisitionBody: {LIEGE} has taken {COUNT} of your stores for the war effort. Food and medicine go where the fighting is, and no one asked your leave.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentBlurb: Pick who marches. They will be away for about {DAYS} days and will return wounded, changed, or not at all. At least {MIN} must go, and you cannot send everyone.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentTooFew: At least {0} able fighters must march.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentTooMany: Someone must stay to hold the colony.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentBusy: A detachment is already in the field.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentUnavailable: No detachment can be raised right now.
LanguageData.ARIO_DetachmentDeparted: {0} marched off to war. Expect them in about {1} days.
LanguageData.ARIO_CampaignWonBody: Of the {SENT} you sent, the field was won. {DEAD} did not come home.
LanguageData.ARIO_CampaignLostBody: Of the {SENT} you sent, the battle was lost. {DEAD} did not come home.
LanguageData.ARIO_BattleOverWonBody: The enemy is broken and the field is yours. Those who fought carry it with them:\n\n{NOTES}
LanguageData.ARIO_BattleOverLostBody: The fighting is over and it did not go your way. What it left behind:\n\n{NOTES}
